articles.title: Your Fitbit data can now connect directly to Apple Health

articles.title: Europe’s AI labeling and transparency rules are now in effect
articles.summary: The European Union has ushered in some additional rules that aim to make it easier for people to identify chatbots and AI deepfakes online.
